content: 1. Iron Field MS, Mithra P, and Pena-Rosas JP conducted a study on the fortification of wheat flour with iron and other micronutrients to reduce anemia and improve iron status in populations. Their findings were published in the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews in 2021 (Issue 1, Article CD011302). 2. Sadighi J, Nedjat S, and Rostami R performed a systematic review and meta-analysis to evaluate the global impact of iron-fortified flour on iron status in populations. Their research was published in Public Health Nutrition in 2019 (Volume 22, Pages 3465–3484). 3. Keats E, Neufeld L, Garrett G, Mbuya M, and Bhutta Z reviewed evidence from large-scale fortification programs in lowand middle-income countries, demonstrating improved micronutrient status and health outcomes. Their systematic review and meta-analysis were published in the American Journal of Clinical Nutrition in 2019 (Volume 109, Pages 1696–1708). 4. Pachon H, Spohrer R, Mei Z, and Serdula MK conducted a systematic review to assess the effectiveness of flour fortification programs in improving iron status and reducing anemia. Their findings were published in Nutrition Reviews in 2015 (Volume 73, Pages 780–795). 5. Athe R, Rao MVV, and Nair KM analyzed the impact of iron-fortified foods on hemoglobin concentrations in children under 10 years of age through a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Their study was published in Public Health Nutrition in 2014 (Volume 17, Pages 579–586). 6. Das J, Salam R, Kumar R, and Bhutta Z reviewed the impact of micronutrient fortification of food on the health of women and children. Their systematic review was published in Systematic Reviews in 2013 (Volume 2, Article 67). 7. Gera T, Sachdev HS, and Boy E conducted a systematic review of randomized controlled trials to evaluate the effects of iron-fortified foods on hematologic and biological outcomes. Their findings were published in the American Journal of Clinical Nutrition in 2012 (Volume 96, Pages 309–324). 8. Centeno Tablante E, Pachon H, Guetterman HM, and Finkelstein JL reviewed the fortification of wheat and maize flour with folic acid and its impact on population health outcomes. Their study was published in the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews in 2019 (Issue 7, Article CD012150). 9. Shah D, Sachdev HS, Gera T, De-Regil LM, and Pena-Rosas JP evaluated the fortification of staple foods with zinc to improve zinc status and other health outcomes in the general population. Their systematic review was published in the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews in 2016 (Issue 6, Article CD010697). 10. Tsang B, Holsted E, McDonald C, Brown K, Black R, Mbuya M, and colleagues conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis on the effects of zinc-fortified foods, either alone or co-fortified with multiple micronutrients, on health and functional outcomes. Their findings were published in Advances in Nutrition in 2021 (Volume 12, Issue 5, Pages 1821–1837), with an erratum published in the same journal (Pages 2040–2044). 11. Hombali AS, Solon JA, Venkatesh BT, Nair NS, and Pena-Rosas JP reviewed the fortification of staple foods with vitamin A to address vitamin A deficiency. Their systematic review was published in the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews in 2019 (Issue 5, Article CD010068).
